title: Underlying sheaf maps are determined by nested completed scalar tensor sections
statement: For a nested completed scalar extension, equality of the underlying sheaf morphism components on every nested completed scalar tensor section implies equality of the underlying presheaf morphisms.

proof.text: Apply the sheafification adjunction to the underlying morphisms and use tensor induction first in the inner completed scalar tensor and then in the outer tensor; the hypothesis identifies the nested pure tensors, and sheafification preserves the resulting equality.
